paragraphs: If your SLC180 has the M270 1.6-litre 4-cylinder petrol engine - that's all SLC180 models across the full 2016-2020 R172 generation - timing chain wear is a recognised pattern on this engine family, shared with the broader M270/M274 range used across C-Class and other models of the same era. We replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every M270 rebuild.
